You are adversarially verifying an audit finding about the mootdx project at /workspace.

FINDING
  symbol: sample.verify_server.select_best_ip / __select_market_code / QA_fetch_get_stock_day / QA_fetch_get_stock_min / QA_fetch_get_stock_latest / QA_fetch_get_stock_realtime / QA_fetch_get_stock_list / QA_fetch_get_index_day / QA_fetch_get_index_min / __QA_fetch_get_stock_transaction / QA_fetch_get_stock_transaction / QA_fetch_get_stock_xdxr / QA_fetch_get_stock_block / QA_fetch_get_stock_info
  kind:   missing
  detail: Spec items 77-90 place the whole QUANTAXIS-style function family in sample/verify_server.py. /workspace/sample/verify_server.py is a 7-line script that only calls `bestip()` and defines zero functions. All 14 named symbols actually live in /workspace/sample/fq.py (module-level defs at lines 52, 69, 76, ... 492), so they exist at the wrong file path. Note for triage: upstream mootdx v0.11.7 also ships verify_server.py as this same 7-line script with the QA_* family in sample/fq.py, so this may be a spec-checklist mis-attribution rather than an implementation regression.
  repro:  python -c "import ast; names=[n.name for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(open('/workspace/sample/verify_server.py').read())) if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)]; print('verify_server funcs:', names)"  # prints: verify_server funcs: []   -- then: python -c "import ast; print([n.name for n in ast.parse(open('/workspace/sample/fq.py').read()).body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)])"  # shows the 14 QA_* symbols living in fq.py

The authoritative spec checklist is /tmp/spec_checklist.md.
Run the repro yourself. Try hard to REFUTE the finding: maybe the symbol exists under a different but
still-importable path, maybe the spec text is loose pseudo-code rather than a literal requirement, maybe
the behaviour already matches. Default to real=false when uncertain or when the "gap" only exists in
spec prose that no plausible test could assert (e.g. a private inner function's exact name).
Set real=true only if a straightforward test written from the spec would fail today.
If real=true, give the minimal concrete fix (which file, what to add).
